comparison.objective: Uncap and spike an IV bag, then prime its chamber; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a bag, pull a cap, drive a spike, and squeeze a chamber versus stabilize a mandrel, strike it, and recover fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Spike locked and chamber one-third to two-thirds full versus four notch fractures with no shell or coil damage.
comparison.reason: Insertion and priming are not impact-fracture manipulation.
